messages.subject: gheatmap error
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,
When I use the gheatmap of ggtree to present the year annotation，the heatmap could be present the heatmap  and just the “Year” title. I had checked my data format and code， and couldn't solve this problem. Could anyone solve this problem？ Many thanks in advace.
library(ape)
library(ggplot2)
library(Biostrings)
library(ggtree)
library(treeio)
tree <- read.tree("gp5new.nwk")
data <- read.table("11.txt", sep="\t", header=TRUE,check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactor=F)
p <- ggtree(tree)
p1<-gheatmap(p, data[,3,drop=FALSE], offset =0.1, width=0.1, font.size=8,low = "green", high = "red", color = "white")
p1

messages.subject: Colour branches of an unrooted tree using a variable
messages.subject_clean: Colour branches of an unrooted tree using a variable
messages.body_plain:
Hi, I have posted this question in Stack Overflow looking for a method in Ape or ggree: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/60285367/how-to-colour-the-branches-of-an-unrooted-tree-using-a-variable-in-r

I would like to generate unrooted neighbour joining trees from input haplotype data, and colour the branches of the trees based on a variable. The haplotypes and co-variables (metadata) are on two separate files with matching sample names. I have been able to produce trees and colour the tips of the trees by variables, but not the tree branches. I am aware of this help document (http://guangchuangyu.github.io/2016/12/edge-coloring-with-user-data/) but have not been able to make the code work.

My code with example data:

# Packages
library('ggplot2')
library('ape')
library('phangorn')
library('dplyr')
library('ggtree')
library('phylobase')

# Generate example haplotype dataframe
Sample <- c('Sample_A', 'Sample_B', 'Sample_C', 'Sample_D', 'Sample_E', 'Sample_F')
SNP_A <- c(0, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1)
SNP_B <- c(0, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1)
SNP_C <- c(0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 0)
SNP_D <- c(1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0)
SNP_E <- c(0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1)
SNP_F <- c(0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1)
df = data.frame(Sample, SNP_A, SNP_B, SNP_C, SNP_D, SNP_E, SNP_F, row.names=c(1))
df

# Generaye example metadata dataframe
Factor_A <- c('a', 'a', 'b', 'b', 'a', 'b')
Factor_B <- c('c', 'd', 'c', 'c', 'd', 'c')
df2 = data.frame(Sample, Factor_A, Factor_B)
df2

# Generate Euclidian pairwise distance matrix
pdist = dist(as.matrix(df), method = "euclidean")

# Turn pairwise distance matrix into phylo via neighbour joining method
phylo_nj <- nj(pdist)

# Example tree plot using Ape
plot(unroot(phylo_nj),
     type="unrooted",
     cex=1,
     use.edge.length=TRUE,
     show.tip.label = TRUE,
     lab4ut="axial",
     edge.width=1.5)

# Plotting in ggtree
mytree <- ggtree(phylo_nj, layout="equal_angle", size=0.5, linetype=1)
mytree

# Adding metadata variables to tree plot
mytree2 <- mytree %<+% df2 + geom_tippoint(aes(shape = Factor_A,
                                               colour = Factor_B),
                                               size = 9,
                                           alpha=0.7)
mytree2

I can't work out how to make the branches coloured by a variable (rather than just the tip points), in either Ape or ggtree. I only want terminal branches coloured, not all of the lines of the tree. My aim is to display two (categorical) variables - one by the branch colour and one by the shape of the tip. A crude version of what I'm after would look something like the image below, with Factor_A coded by tip shape (and a neutral colour as shown) and Factor_B coded by the branch colour. How can I do this with %<+% ?

Thanks for the help,
Will

messages.subject: [Example Provided] How to find ouput order of tip labels ?
messages.subject_clean: [Example Provided] How to find ouput order of tip labels ?
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

Is there a way to find the actual output order of tip labels ?

Here a reproducible example:

nwk <- "((((A, B), C), (D)));"
nwk.tree <- read.tree(text=nwk)

The tree label data order are:

matrix(nwk.tree$tip.label)

    [,1]
[1,] "A"
[2,] "B"
[3,] "C"
[4,] "D"

But the actual ouput order on the y-axis are, fom ymin to ymax: D, C, A, B

nwk.tree.ggtree <- ggtree(nwk.tree) + geom_tiplab()
nwk.tree.ggtree

How can I access this output order from the nwk.tree.ggtree (or the nwk.tree) ?

Many thanks in advance,

Rémi
